veer-bahadur-singh-purvanchal-university.description: Veer Bahadur Singh Purvanchal University is a state university in Jaunpur, accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade, whose engineering institute began in 1997.
veer-bahadur-singh-purvanchal-university.about: The university was established on 2 October 1987 and is a state university of the Government of Uttar Pradesh. Its Uma Nath Singh Institute of Engineering and Technology started in 1997 with three departments. It holds a NAAC A+ grade.

bundelkhand-institute-of-engineering-and.description: Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering and Technology is an autonomous engineering institute on Kanpur Road, Jhansi, affiliated to AKTU.
bundelkhand-institute-of-engineering-and.about: The foundation stone was laid in 1986, and the institute began operating in 1988 as Bundelkhand Engineering College. It has been autonomous since 2011-12 under UGC. It is affiliated to Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University for its B.Tech, M.Tech and MBA degrees.
bundelkhand-institute-of-engineering-and.affiliated_to: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
